name: Manufacturing Process Decision Evaluation
description: Multi-primitive TypeSafe decision evaluation dataset featuring Noul (binary), Choice (categorical), and Score (ordinal rubric) quality gates.

questions.name: yield_target_met
questions.instructions: Does the production lot yield strictly meet or exceed the baseline target (>= 98.5%)?

criteria.true: Yield meets or exceeds 98.5% with zero lot rejection.
criteria.false: Yield fell below 98.5% or lot was placed on quality hold.

questions.name: line_stoppage_flag
questions.instructions: Did the line experience an unscheduled stoppage or downtime event exceeding 10 minutes?

criteria.true: Unscheduled stoppage, machine crash, or downtime > 10 minutes occurred.
criteria.false: Continuous line operation with zero or minor (< 10 min) pauses.

questions.name: parameter_drift
questions.instructions: Did key process parameters (pressure, temperature, RF power, or solder volume) drift beyond 3-sigma control limits?

criteria.true: Parameter excursion, plasma drift, or control limit violation detected.
criteria.false: All control parameters remained within 3-sigma statistical control.

questions.name: root_cause_documented
questions.instructions: Is a specific root cause or mechanical fault mechanism explicitly identified in the log?

criteria.true: Specific fault mechanism or equipment failure reason is stated.

questions.name: primary_defect_type
questions.instructions: Which defect category is primarily identified in this production run?

criteria.solder_bridging: Solder bridging, tombstoning, or short circuit defects on PCBA.
criteria.rf_plasma_drift: RF plasma excursion, reflected power spike, or etch chamber drift.
criteria.porosity: Internal porosity, cold shut, or air entrapment in casting.
criteria.thermal_gradient: Thermal gradient, DC-IR imbalance, or cell temperature runaway.
criteria.none: Within spec, no non-conformance or defect detected.

questions.name: disposition_recommendation
questions.instructions: What is the recommended quality disposition action for this production lot?

criteria.direct_release: Direct release to finished goods inventory; process verified conforming.
criteria.rework_inspect: Rework or secondary AOI screening required prior to downstream assembly.
criteria.containment_quarantine: Immediate physical quarantine hold in Sector B; engineering review required.
criteria.scrap_disposal: Total lot rejection and scrap authorization due to unrecoverable excursion.

questions.name: excursion_severity_index
questions.instructions: How severe is the line disturbance or parameter excursion reported in this log?
criteria: Nominal continuous flow with zero unscheduled downtime and telemetry strictly within standard control envelope.
Minor nuisance alarm or transient pause cleared rapidly with negligible scrap impact (< 0.5%).
Moderate excursion with unscheduled tool stoppage or partial lot hold requiring 100% sorting or rework.
Critical equipment breakdown, thermal runaway hazard, or major lot scrap event.

questions.name: documentation_completeness
questions.instructions: How thorough and complete is the shift engineering log?
criteria: Minimal or vague log entry lacking quantitative telemetry, timestamps, or root-cause notes.
Standard operational summary with basic yield figures and fault flags.
Comprehensive audit log with full SPC telemetry, root-cause isolation, and technician signature.

states.title: Bay 3 Etch Chamber B - Plasma Drift & Excursion
states.state:
EQUIPMENT INCIDENT LOG: DRY ETCH BAY 3 Equipment ID: Lam-Kiyo-Chamber-B Tool State: DOWN - INTERRUPTED Timestamp: 11:42:18 UTC | Recipe: Poly_Gate_Etch_v12 Lot ID: WF-2026-90412 (25 Wafers)

INCIDENT DETAILS:
At step 4 of main etch (38s elapsed), RF match network auto-tuning failed. Reflected RF power spiked to 145W (Permissible upper limit: 15W). Chamber pressure surged from nominal 12.0 mTorr to 48.5 mTorr within 3.2 seconds due to turbo throttle valve hunting.

INTERVENTION:
Optical emission spectrometer (OES) endpoint trigger failed. EMO interlock triggered automatic plasma dump and N2 purge.
- Unscheduled Downtime: 85 minutes active tool stoppage.
- Wafer Inspection: 4 wafers (#21-#25) suffered severe over-etch trench punch-through. Lot yield estimated at 84.0%.
- Root Cause Identified: Turbo molecular pump foreline pressure sensor transducer calibration drifted by +34% due to polymer byproduct buildup.

ACTION:
Lot quarantined in Sector B. Preventative clean required before requalification.

states.title: Die Cast Cell 2 - Cold Shut & Ladle Misfeed
states.state:
CELL RUN LOG: DIE CASTING UNIT #2 Machine: 850T Toshiba Cold Chamber Die Caster Part: Transmission Housing Cover (Alloy: A380 Aluminum) Date: Current Shift

PROCESS TELEMETRY:
- Shot Count: 620 cycles attempted, 541 acceptable parts.
- Run Yield: 87.25% (Target threshold: >= 98.50% - FAILED).
- Metal Temperature: Ladle pyrometer recorded molten metal dipping to 642C (Spec limit: 670C +- 10C) between cycles 180 and 240.
- Injection Profile: Fast shot velocity 4.2 m/s, intensification pressure 78 MPa.

DEFECT ANALYSIS:
- 79 parts rejected at automated ultrasonic inspection due to visible cold shuts and wall porosity along the rear fluid mounting flange.
- Unscheduled Line Stoppage: Unit halted for 42 minutes to purge ladle delivery nozzle and replace heating immersion thermocouple.
- Root Cause: Ladle pre-heater burner pilot failure led to thermal loss in transfer trough.

STATUS:
Total lot quarantined for 100% acoustic resonance testing. Scrap authorization pending metallurgical review.

states.title: Formation Rack 04 - Thermal Runaway Risk Flag
states.state:
LINE DISPATCH: EV BATTERY FORMATION & AGING Line: Formation Hall 2, Rack Matrix 04 Cell Format: 4680 Cylindrical High-Nickel NMC Lot: BAT-4680-LOT88

INSPECTION SUMMARY:
- Lot Size: 1,440 cells under C/10 formation charge protocol.
- Overall Yield: 96.8% (Target: >= 98.50% - FAILED).

THERMAL & PARAMETRIC EXCURSIONS:
- Multi-point IR thermal scanner flagged Channel 82 and Channel 83: Surface temperature escalated to 64.8C during step 3 constant-current charge (Threshold cutoff: 55.0C).
- DC-IR (Internal Resistance) testing showed 18 cells with internal resistance exceeding 22.4 mOhm (Spec nominal: 14.5 +- 2.0 mOhm).
- Automated fire suppression pre-action solenoid armed. Line automatically switched to fail-safe isolated discharge.
- Stoppage Duration: Formation circuit suspended for 58 minutes during cooldown and nitrogen blanket verification.
- Root Cause: Localized separator pinhole puncture from burr on negative electrode slit edge.

ACTION:
Tray 04 quarantined. Defective cells rejected. Remaining cells shifted to 14-day extended open-circuit voltage degradation monitoring.
